name: quote-aware csv parser (stdlib csv module)
note: The alternate branch for `agit fork`. Same failing test, different solution, so `agit diff` has something real to compare.

steps.why: Re-read the parser at the fork point: the failing test exists, the fix does not.
Hand-rolling a quote scanner means owning every edge case forever. The standard library already implements RFC 4180, so delegate and keep the trimming behaviour callers rely on.
Prove the delegated implementation satisfies both the new and the old tests.
Suite is green with a third of the code, so stop here.

args.summary: Replaced the naive split with csv.reader instead of a hand-written scanner: ~35 fewer lines to maintain and RFC 4180 edge cases come for free. Trade-off: csv.reader allocates a reader per line, so the hand-rolled scanner is faster on very hot paths. Same four quoted-field tests pass.
